summary: Handheld cloud-shaped virtual pet: FDM shell holding a directly socketed XIAO ESP32-S3, user-selected YouXin 1.3in 240x240 ST7789 7-pin TFT, LiPo and three buttons.

required_interfaces.description: Seat the selected 27.78x39.22 mm YouXin 7-pin display PCB; expose its 23.4x23.4 mm active area. Include the pre-soldered header and mating cable envelope using disclosed defaults where the seller supplies no height.
XIAO ESP32-S3 USB-C reachable through the shell for charging and flashing
Three domed caps pressing 6x6 mm tactile switches
Direct-plug XIAO/key/7P TFT carrier; 7-pin plug-in cable replaces Grove by user choice. Preserve USB position and three button axes.

external_references.description: Reference photo of a lobed handheld pet with square screen and three buttons
Cloud icon whose bumpy outline the shell edge follows
Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3 wiki (dimensions, pin map)
Selected 1.3-inch metal-frame 7P pre-soldered YouXin TFT variant
Seller table: 1.3-inch column gives ST7789,240x240,3.3V,SPI and dimensions
Use upper 1.3-inch 7P drawing only; lower drawing is another module
Seller interface definitions; 1.3-inch lacks CS and BLK is low-off

assembly_story.installation: Fit XIAO on its carrier, seat battery, and mount the selected YouXin display with its matching bezel and supports. Connect the display using the seven-pin straight-through female cable; verify header and cable clearances before lowering front assembly and closing rear screws.
assembly_story.maintenance: Remove the back screws to replace the battery.

designs.description: Cloud-lobed two-piece shell with screen window, bezel and button caps
